description: This file defines an enum named AllocationType representing different types of allocations (Penalty, Fee, Principal, Interest) used within the loan product domain in the Fineract project. It includes a method to convert enum values into a list of EnumOptionData objects for UI or API purposes.

classes.name: AllocationType
classes.description: An enum representing different allocation types in the loan product context, with a human-readable name and a method to get all enum values as a list of EnumOptionData objects.

methods.name: getValuesAsEnumOptionDataList
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData objects representing all allocation types with their ordinal-based ID, name, and human-readable name.
